taxonomy.label: Divestiture
taxonomy.definition: A stated intention to sell a business.

taxonomy.label: Asset value discount
taxonomy.definition: The market price sits below a defensible appraisal of the assets.

taxonomy.label: Special situation
taxonomy.definition: The return depends on a discrete corporate event rather than operations.

taxonomy.label: Turnaround
taxonomy.definition: A troubled business where the thesis is repair, under new management or a new plan.

taxonomy.label: Corporate action
taxonomy.definition: A spin-off, sale, merger or similar.

taxonomy.label: Margin inflection
taxonomy.definition: Margins are expected to turn, and that turn carries the thesis.

taxonomy.label: Activist engagement
taxonomy.definition: A public campaign or engagement by the manager.

taxonomy.label: Management change
taxonomy.definition: A named change in senior management.

taxonomy.label: One to three years
taxonomy.definition: The manager expects the thesis to resolve between one and three years out.

taxonomy.label: Three to five years
taxonomy.definition: The manager expects the thesis to resolve between three and five years out.

taxonomy.label: Competitive erosion
taxonomy.definition: A named competitor threatens the economics.

taxonomy.label: Execution risk
taxonomy.definition: The plan may not be delivered.

taxonomy.label: Leverage risk
taxonomy.definition: The balance sheet limits the manager's tolerance.

taxonomy.label: Multiple re-rating
taxonomy.definition: The thesis requires the multiple to rise, not just earnings.

taxonomy.label: Sum of the parts
taxonomy.definition: Value is argued segment by segment.
